ComponentRef.description: A component's id (a number) or its name.

ParentPath.description: An exact placement path: up to 63 occurrence ids from the root down; empty for the design itself.

input.description:
Make a new component, in the active component unless `parent` says another, and make it the
active one unless `activate` is false. The design's first part is grounded; the others are
not. Bodies are not moved here (`component.move_bodies`, `component.from_bodies`).

activate.description: Make it the active component. Default: `true`.

grounded.description: Ground its placement. Default: `true` for the design's first part, `false` otherwise.

name.description: The new component's name. Default: a name made from the design's naming.

parent.description: The component to put it in, by id or name. Default: the active one.

parent_path.description:
The exact placement of the parent to place it by, as occurrence ids from the top of the
design (up to 63; none is the design itself). It must belong to the parent. Default: the
active placement when the parent is the active component, else the parent's first.

label: New Component

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

parent.description: The component it is in, by id (0 is the design).

params: name?, parent?: component id or name (default: the active one); parent_path?: exact parent placement; activate?: bool (default true); grounded?: bool (default: true for the design's first part, false otherwise)
